policy: Change detection only, not semantic equivalence. A bare digest refresh is not a valid disposition; review both modes and update the per-pair rationale. No wall-clock production or CI action.

pairs.rationale: ON retains the reviewed shortened duties; OFF preserves pre-savings text at f022a0a7. Any shared duty change must update both modes and the historical compatibility evidence. FLY-2597 adds the same explicit founderAsk, reply acknowledgement, shared title/page attention, no periodic prose and quiet-record duties to ON and OFF; existing historical duties outside that exact insertion are preserved. Reproduction: engineering/doc/FLY-2597-thread-title-needs-you/capture-rule-evolution.py verifies the historical bundle before replaying its pinned patch. FLY-2655 adds the same manifest-only voice session start, status and stop duty to ON and OFF; both modes reject shell, legacy huddle and caller-supplied authority fields, preserve request identity on replay, and do not claim real audio success from request acceptance. FLY-2922 reviewed both ON and OFF close/archiving duties. Both use the identical compact close section: execution-only closure references the resident R2 receipt/recovery contract; done is not completion authority; archive requires genuine run completion. Both preserve wrap-up delivery, wait for founder/no close suggestion, R2 authorization, no direct Discord PATCH, no archive on abort, ship archive, reopen/archive-once, and the unchanged backlog endpoint. Compaction stays within the original bundle budget without weakening its guard.
